title: Territory Manager Americas
description:
Mixscience recrute un (une) Territory Manager Americas

à Brazil

CDI

Acteur majeur de la nutrition animale en France et à l'international, MiXscience est une société qui s'adresse aux fabricants d'aliments, aux intégrateurs et aux distributeurs afin de contribuer au développement des filières d'élevage durables. Ses 500 collaborateurs en France et à l’international développent et commercialisent une offre produit composée de prémix, minéraux, spécialités innovantes et solutions de biocontrôle adaptées à différentes espèces.

Le poste peut être basé dans la zone LATAM, pas obligatoirement au Brésil.

Quels seront les enjeux du poste et votre contribution ?

Vous intégrerez l'équipe commerciale internationale de Mixscience et contribuerez au développement de notre présence commerciale sur les marchés stratégiques d’Amérique Latine et des États-Unis. En tant que Territory Manager, vous serez responsable de définir et de mettre en œuvre la stratégie commerciale sur ces marchés, et serez l’ambassadeur de MiXscience dans la zone (promotion des produits, opérations commerciales, représentation de la marque).

Vos principales missions seront :

  • Identifier les opportunités B2B, sélectionner les distributeurs et construire un plan de développement des ventes adapté aux spécificités locales
  • Assurer la prospection, le suivi des clients et la promotion des solutions MiXscience, tout en veillant à leur conformité avec les réglementations en vigueur
  • Animer un réseau de partenaires, gérer les opérations commerciales (commandes, facturation, litiges, appels d’offres, recouvrement) et fixer les conditions tarifaires en lien avec la direction
  • Réaliser une veille concurrentielle constante et assurer une coordination fluide avec les équipes internes
  • Assurer un reporting régulier et structuré de l’activité auprès de la direction
  • Encadrer et accompagner les Account Managers de la zone, veiller à la bonne exécution de la stratégie commerciale, au développement des compétences et à leur autonomie

Vous êtes issu(e) d’une formation supérieure, idéalement en commerce international, en agronomie ou dans un domaine connexe. Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée dans le développement commercial à l’international, avec une bonne connaissance des marchés d’Amérique Latine et des États-Unis. Une expérience dans le secteur de la nutrition animale, des additifs ou de l’agroalimentaire serait un atout.

Vous avez évolué dans un environnement B2B exigeant, où vous avez démontré votre capacité à structurer une approche marché, à développer un portefeuille clients et à construire des partenariats durables. Vous êtes à l’aise dans la gestion de projets complexes et savez coordonner efficacement les actions entre les équipes internes et les partenaires externes.

Doté(e) d’un leadership, vous avez une première expérience réussie en management d’équipe, avec une capacité à accompagner, motiver et faire progresser vos collaborateurs. Reconnu(e) pour votre autonomie, rigueur, sens de l’analyse et capacité à prendre des décisions dans un environnement en constante évolution. La maîtrise de l’anglais et de l’espagnol est indispensable, tout comme une grande aisance relationnelle et une forte capacité d’adaptation à des contextes multiculturels.

L’aventure vous tente ? N’hésitez plus !

1. Faites-vous connaître. Envoyez-nous votre CV.

2. Vous avez suscité notre curiosité ? Nous vous contacterons pour un premier échange.

3. Si la suite vous convient, un entretien avec votre futur manager et votre RH vous attend.

4. Bienvenue ! Notre collaboration va commencer, hâte de vous retrouver.

Mixscience est une filiale d’Avril, leader industriel et financier de la filière française des huiles et protéines végétales. Présent dans l'alimentation humaine, la nutrition et les expertises animales, les énergies et la chimie renouvelables, Avril a réalisé en 2023 un chiffre d'affaires de 8 milliards d'euros dans 19 pays. Le Groupe fonde sa croissance sur un modèle unique de partage de la valeur. Guidé par sa raison d'être, "Servir la Terre", Avril s'engage avec ses 8 000 collaborateurs pour répondre aux défis du climat et de la croissance démographique. Travailler chez Avril, c’est faire le choix d’une entreprise qui réconcilie performance et responsabilité, innovation et humilité, collectif et individu. avril.com | X @Avril | LinkedIn Avril

This role requires strong communication, analytical thinking, and the ability to simplify complex business needs into compelling value propositions. Reporting to our Brazil Commercial Director, you’ll collaborate across cross-functional teams and work closely with E-commerce stakeholders in payments, operations, product, and risk If you're a resilient self-starter with a passion for consultative selling and driving impact in a fast-growing market—this is your opportunity to make a difference!

  • Create and share learnings internally with the global sales team

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 6+ years of experience in SaaS Hunter Sales or Business Development
  • Strong analytical skills, able to tell a story using numbers and analysis, and able to handle objections in a convincing manner.
  • Strong communicator, able to prepare impactful professional presentations and selling materials.
  • Self-paced, autonomous and resilient, with the ability to work well with little guidance and capable to deliver results on a constant basis.
  • Able to travel to meet up with merchants, to industry events, to company planning and training sessions.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

  • Preferred professional background in complex sales environments such as Fraud, Payments, B2B SaaS Technology or E-commerce.
  • Preferred educational background in Engineering, Economics or Business Administration.

Ownership: At Swapcard, we take responsibility and are accountable for our actions, driving success through initiative, trust, and accountability. title: Cloud Support Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Cloud Support Engineer role at Canonical

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Cloud Support Engineer role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Cloud Support Engineer to build a career with Canonical and support the technical needs of customers leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have an affinity for open source development and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
We regularly solve interesting, technical problems. From triaging complex Cloud environment issues, Linux kernel crashes we've never seen before to OS configuration issues and root cause analysis, we provide an expert level of support and satisfaction to our peer groups and customers. We are rapidly expanding and are looking for talented problem solvers with a passion for working on the next generation of Ubuntu solutions for our customers.
Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.
The role entails

  • Investigate issues reported by customers by researching and escalating issues
  • Work to resolve complex customer problems related to Canonical's portfolio of products.
  • Ownership of results: Ensure that each support case owned by you is handled according to our Service Level Agreement (SLA) with the highest possible customer satisfaction by setting the right expectations and fulfilling your commitments.
  • Engage directly with customers and work collaboratively by phone, ticketing system, and remote sessions to resolve their issues.
  • Participate in a regular weekend working rotation.
  • Contribute new knowledge base articles and maintain existing articles, ensuring shared knowledge and lessons learned are available to customers.
  • Understanding Ubuntu development process to be able to set customer expectations correctly on timeline for a fix.
What are we looking for in you
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Hands-on and extensive working experience in supporting Linux systems including 3 or more of:
    • Virtualization / Cloud - primarily using KVM or OpenStack.
    • Containers - especially with Docker, LXD/LXC, or Kubernetes.
    • Storage technologies - block, object and network.
    • Networking (bonding, firewalling, bridging, switching, network file system tuning, MTU issues, etc.).
  • Cloud computing expertise in provisioning, monitoring, orchestration, etc.
  • Advanced troubleshooting experience:
    • Linux integration with other environments (authentication/directory services, network file systems, etc.).
    • Ability to navigate effectively stack traces and logs, and advise on next steps.
    • Solid understanding of OS and Application level bugs and when to escalate to the correct team.
  • Programming fundamentals in any language.
  • Extensive Customer support experience is key:
    • Customer needs are top priority.
    • Communicate professionally, emphatically, clearly and set the right expectations.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Content Strategist & Creator
description:
Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

we are: At 2 Brothers Moving & Delivery our mission is to remove the pain of relocation for Portlanders and beyond. This is a remote position based in Central or South America with periodic travel to Portland, Oregon for content creation.
We're Portland's highest-rated moving service, and we need someone who can be the brain AND the hands behind our entire content operation. Not just someone who posts pretty pictures, but someone who understands what drives business, can develop strategy that actually works, and isn't afraid to get on job sites to capture the real moments that make people trust us with their most valuable stuff.
This role combines strategy, content creation, writing, and social media management into one powerhouse position. You'll work directly with our founder to develop content that converts stressed-out homeowners into customers who choose us over cheaper competitors. Plus, you get to travel to Portland (all expenses paid) to gather authentic content that you can't get from a desk.
Benefits of Career Opportunities at 2 Brothers:

  • Own the entire content strategy—your ideas actually shape our marketing direction
  • All travel, lodging, food, and expenses covered for Portland content trips
  • Work directly with the founder, no corporate bureaucracy or endless approval chains
  • Steady monthly income in USD while living in your home country
  • Build portfolio with content that drives real business results, not just vanity metrics
  • Creative freedom to develop authentic brand voice that stands out from boring competitors
We're looking for a Content Strategist & Creator who can think strategically AND execute flawlessly. You'll develop our content strategy, travel to Portland to capture authentic footage and photos, write everything from social captions to blog posts, and manage our social media presence. This isn't just posting content—it's building a content machine that drives real business growth.
Responsibilities:
  • Strategic Content Planning - Develop quarterly and monthly content strategies that align with business goals, research competitors, analyze what's working, and plan content calendars that actually drive leads and conversions
  • On-Site Content Creation - Travel to Portland periodically to film real moving jobs, interview customers, capture behind-the-scenes moments, and gather photo/video content that showcases our premium service and authentic brand personality
  • AI Content Writing That Converts - Utilize AI to write compelling social media captions, blog posts, email newsletters, SMS, website copy, and other content that educates prospects and converts them into customers who choose quality over price
  • Social Media Management - Post daily content across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and TikTok, engage with followers, respond to comments, and build online community that drives word-of-mouth referrals
  • Content Performance & Optimization - Track what content drives actual business results, optimize posting schedules and messaging, and continuously improve strategy based on real data, not just likes and follows
This role reports directly to the Sales & Admin Manager.
Work Environment: Remote position based in Central or South America with periodic travel to Portland, Oregon (all expenses paid). Flexible schedule with project-based deadlines. Must have valid visa for US travel and strong English communication skills.
Qualifications:
  • Exceptional skills in utilizing AI to generate automation and on brand content without sounding like AI did it
  • Valid US visa and ability to travel freely between your home country and United States
  • 2-3 years experience developing and executing social media strategies that drive actual business results
  • Strong writing skills in English—you can explain complex topics simply and create captions that stop the scroll
  • Experience with content planning, social media scheduling tools, and analytics
  • Comfortable filming video and taking photos on job sites during fast-paced work environments
  • Understanding of Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and TikTok—what works on each platform and why
  • Self-starter who can work independently across time zones without constant hand-holding
  • Bonus points: Experience with service businesses, B2B content, or working with premium brands
What we DON'T want:
  • "Social media managers" who just repost motivational quotes and call it strategy
  • People who think more followers automatically means more business
  • Content creators who need perfect conditions to produce good work
  • Anyone who's never actually tracked how their content impacts business revenue
Compensation: $1,500-1,800 USD monthly rate based on experience and proven track record of driving business results with content strategy.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We require an HR function that thinks and acts globally. We're looking for a Lead HR Generalist to offer their expertise to our AMER region. It's an exciting time to join with the opportunity to help shape and create an HR function for the future. The senior role will serve as a driver and practitioner in both regional and global HR initiatives. You will join a global team of HR professionals to provide precise, compliant and scalable HR operations to the business, advise and execute on HR issues across the whole employee life-cycle, and partner with leadership in your region. You will have an analytical approach, a keen eye for detail and the ability to interpret data trends and themes.

  • Work with managers across the business on performance management, organizational design, employee engagement, rewards- and workforce planning
  • Partner with the HRIS team to develop and refine operational processes for day to day HR administration
  • Coach and advise people managers on the full spectrum of employee relations issues across multiple countries
  • Partner with people managers to support the delivery of appropriate training and development programs
  • Establish a trusted partnership with the business in your region
  • Drive diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives
  • Design new policies and deliver on business-critical HR related projects globally

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • HR experience leading initiatives across regions within a technology business
  • Regional HR experience within Latin America (Brazil and/or Mexico is a plus), with an understanding of local labor laws, competitive awareness and insights
  • Experience in business partnering with senior stakeholders
  • A good balance between leading and executing, in this role you will need to be hands-on involved in the daily HR routines
  • Experience mentoring and developing others
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to define done and keep deliverables on track
  • Experience in working in a remote first organization
  • Able to leverage data to make informed decisions
  • Fluent in business English (written and spoken)
  • Self motivated, organized, accurate, confident, authentic, results-orientated, open-minded and enthusiastic
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

  • Experience with immigration policies and mobility processes
  • Payroll and/or benefits oversight experience
  • Knowledge of HR Systems and databases
  • Professional HR certification(s)
  • Facilitation skills

title: People Operations Manager
description:
We’re looking for an HR leader who thinks strategically, sees the big picture, spots patterns before they become problems, and takes action before issues arise. This is an HR leadership role where you’ll be in the driver’s seat, ensuring our international workforce runs smoothly, employees stay engaged, and clients get a seamless experience.

The Role

If you’re the kind of person who can juggle onboarding, employee relations, and client interactions—all while keeping an eagle-eye view on data, trends, and workforce health—this is your chance to own and evolve HR in a fast-scaling, remote-first company.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

  1. Onboarding & Offboarding – Ensure a seamless, structured experience for every remote hire, from first touch to full integration. When employees exit, you’ll make sure nothing falls through the cracks.
  2. Employee Relations & Wellness Checks – Keep a pulse on engagement, performance, and morale across a fully remote, global team. Solve problems before they escalate and build a culture where employees feel connected and supported.
  3. Client Communication – Act as a trusted HR partner to our U.S. clients, ensuring they have a direct line for onboarding concerns and HR-related needs.
  4. HR Reporting & Metrics – Leverage data and insights to anticipate issues before they arise. You won’t just report on workforce trends—you’ll use them to proactively improve employee satisfaction, retention, and efficiency.

Ideal Profile

WHO YOU ARE

  1. Remote HR Expert – You understand the complexities of managing a global workforce and keeping employees engaged across time zones.
  2. Strategic Problem-Solver – You connect the dots, spot trends, and resolve challenges before they become problems.
  3. People & Process Pro – Employees trust you. Clients rely on you. You know how to manage relationships, handle sensitive issues, and keep everything running smoothly.
  4. Tech-Savvy & Detail-Oriented – You’re analytical and data-driven, using HR tools to streamline operations and stay ahead of potential issues.

WHY JOIN US?

We’re growing fast—and we need someone who can grow with us. This isn’t just an HR job. It’s an opportunity to shape the future of a thriving international staffing company, take ownership, and drive impact.

If you’re ready to be at the center of a high-growth, people-first company, let’s talk.
